_note: Item ids sourced from Method's Midnight 12.1 consumables guide.
Audience: mana potions are caster-only (melee specs have no mana bar),
weapon stones are melee (attack power, weapon-type restricted), oils are
the caster-side equivalent. Everything else in Midnight is genuinely
universal because flasks key on secondary stat, not primary stat.
ARCHIVAL: exactly one catalog is 'active' and is the only one collected.
When Midnight ends, set its status to 'archived' and add the next
expansion as a new active catalog. Archived prices are never deleted and
the page stays browsable at /wow/consumables/{id}, just frozen.
Ranks discovered from the live EU snapshot: same item name, actually
trading, ordered by ITEM LEVEL -- which is the real rank discriminator.
Item ids are NOT ordered by rank, so do not infer rank from the id.
Six items (foods and the feast) genuinely have a single rank.
Patch dates are release dates, not raid-opening dates: 12.1 shipped
2026-08-11 and the Venomous Abyss opened a week later. Windows are
derived from these starts and are contiguous by construction.
The Void-Touched Augment Rune (259085) DOES exist and trades heavily; an
earlier note here claimed it was absent from Blizzard's item data, which
was wrong. Vantus runes are tracked per raid tier, one entry per tier.
BoEs are NOT commodities: they are auctioned per connected realm, one at a
time, at several item levels under one item id. They live in their own
table (realm_price_samples) and are filtered with realm_tracked_ids().
Recipes are per-realm like BoEs. Their profession is Blizzard's own item
subclass, so unlike reagents they are generated rather than curated.
